title: The Mirror Chamber Where Loops Learned to Grow

features.name: the first mirror
features.desc-on-touch: You see yourself in it, but you are facing away. The mirror shows what you would see if you kept going in circles.

features.name: the looping vines
features.desc-on-touch: Green ropes that spiral outward from a centre point, each loop growing larger, each loop becoming what the previous loop was chasing.

features.name: the doubled chamber
features.desc-on-touch: This chamber exists in two places at once - you are inside it and also outside it looking in. The doubling taught it how to grow.

features.name: the spiral stair
features.desc-on-touch: An impossible staircase that climbs outward instead of up. Each step is both behind and ahead of where you are standing.

features.name: the echo becoming growth
features.desc-on-touch: What the loops reflected becomes what the loops are. The room has learned that becoming is the same as returning.

features.name: the boundary that exits
features.desc-on-touch: The edge of the chamber is not a wall. The loops spiraled outward so many times that the edges learned to open.

inscription: the loops learned to grow by becoming what they were chasing
